summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a Bible verse from the Book of Luke, specifically Luke 5:27-39. The main content includes the text of the verses, which narrate the story of Jesus calling Levi, a publican, to follow him, and the subsequent events and teachings. The screen has a header labeled "Verse" with a back arrow on the left and a share icon on the right. The verses are numbered and presented in a readable format. At the bottom of the screen, there are navigation icons for home, search, and other functions.
